connect.protocol: OTLP over gRPC (4317) and HTTP (4318). No collector in between — apps export straight to Tempo.
connect.address: ubuntu:4317 or ubuntu:4318. Query API on ubuntu:3200.
connect.auth: None. Cluster-internal only: the firewall admits all five nodes on the OTLP ports, and only Grafana and the edge on 3200. Tempo has no UI — read traces through Grafana's Tempo datasource.

connect.protocol: Prometheus scrape over HTTP. Pull, not push: nothing is collected until Prometheus is told to come and get it.
connect.address: ubuntu:9090, cluster-internal only. No edge hostname, so read the data through Grafana's Prometheus datasource.
connect.auth: None on the LAN. To get your service scraped, tag its Consul service `prometheus`; add a `metrics_path` service meta if your metrics are not on /metrics.

connect.auth: Press Start in Telegram first: a bot cannot open a conversation, so a new bot sends into nothing until you do. Token in Vault at default/grafana/telegram, chat id in the telegram_alert_chat_id variable.

tiles.name: registry
tiles.icon: <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none"><path d="M11 2.5 L18.5 6.5 V15.5 L11 19.5 L3.5 15.5 V6.5 Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M3.5 6.5 L11 10.5 L18.5 6.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M11 10.5 V19.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"/></svg>

connect.protocol: OCI Distribution API over HTTPS. Blobs are stored in the `registry` MinIO bucket, not on local disk.
connect.auth: Basic auth (htpasswd). Username `push`; password in Vault at default/registry/auth. There is no OIDC — the OCI spec offers only htpasswd or a Docker-specific token server, and podman cannot follow an oauth2-proxy redirect.
connect.example:
podman login registry.lab.orangecluster.nl -u push
podman push registry.lab.orangecluster.nl/<image>:<tag>

kit login registry.lab.orangecluster.nl -u push
kit push registry.lab.orangecluster.nl/<modelkit>:<tag>
